# iRacing SDK 1.20 protocol evidence

The implementation in `IncidentReview.Iracing` transcribes the shared-memory ABI and replay-broadcast constants from `irsdk-1-20.zip` (SHA-256 `af4948cc8efe03fa7c99332a63da1ab9d7b34e5b6107540c176ed682e48a2d79`), reviewed 2026-09-06. No upstream source file or binary is redistributed here.
